summary: Phase 9C round 3 backend regression — masters.py + customers.py router extraction is byte-identical. New pytest suite (45 tests) + prior phase9c refactor suite (21 tests) = 66/66 pass. LLM UAT (uat_llm_files.py) exit=0 with 0 failures. All 25 extracted OpenAPI paths present. Cascade rename on PUT /api/customers/{cid} verified — customer_id change propagates to customer_pos and downstream. Frontend MatVarChips component verified present in both mrf/[id].tsx and po/[id].tsx with correct MAT-/VAR- fallback logic; no UI walkthrough performed per request.

P0_masters.POST /materials: 403 for site_engineer/pm/gm/store; 400 empty desc / >100 words / duplicate norm; 200 purchase → pending_pm_review; 200 admin → approved
P0_masters.PUT /materials/{uid}: 400 without reason; approved+purchase → pending_gm_approval; admin edit stays approved; dedup enforced on rename
P0_masters.POST /materials/{uid}/action: PM approve OK; 403 purchase/gm; 400 wrong status
P0_masters.POST /materials/{uid}/gm-approve: GM only; 403 purchase; 400 if not pending_gm_approval
P0_masters.POST /materials/bulk-action: PM bulk → {ok:3, skipped:2} correctly counts already-approved + bogus uid
P0_masters.GET /import/materials/template: xlsx bytes returned; ?token= query param path works for browser download
P0_masters.POST /import/materials: created/duplicates/errors/needs_correction/summary all populated correctly with mixed rows
P0_masters.GET+POST /variants: list ok; duplicate combo returns same variant_uid
P0_masters.GET+POST+PUT+DELETE /masters: list grouped; POST forbidden for purchase; dup name case-insensitive → 400; PUT requires reason → 400; DELETE is soft (active=false)

P0_customers.GET /customers: default active-only + po_count attached; ?include_inactive=true returns deactivated
P0_customers.POST /customers: 403 for pm/purchase/gm; dup on customer_id AND name both case-insensitive → 400
P0_customers.PUT /customers/{cid} cascade_rename: customer_id change cascades to customer_pos (verified — cpo still present under new cid); old cid returns 404
P0_customers.PUT /customers/{cid}/pos/{cpo_id}: returns without attachment_b64; audit log redacts base64 as [file] (code-verified in customers.py:203-206)

P1_cross_router.POST /api/mrf with material_id=MAT-0001: admin creates MRF successfully → masters router resolves seeded material against materials collection
P1_cross_router.existing test_phase9c_refactor.py: 21/21 pass (notifications, reports, audit RBAC, settings PUT matrix, P2 smoke, OpenAPI)

P3_frontend_chip.mrf_detail_import: /app/frontend/app/mrf/[id].tsx:12+287 — fallback to material_id / variant_id when starts with MAT-/VAR-
P3_frontend_chip.rationale: Component is a conditional Text render; backend green; no UI risk in this pass per request

coverage_matrix.rbac_drift_check: No RBAC behaviour changes detected vs. pre-refactor. Materials write-role set (purchase/admin/director) preserved. Customers write-role set (admin/director) preserved. Customer POs write-role set (admin/director/purchase) preserved. master-audit remains admin/director-only.
coverage_matrix.cascade_rename_verification: customer_id rename explicitly tested end-to-end — after PUT with new customer_id, GET on old cid returns 404 and GET on new cid returns the attached customer_pos row (proving customer_pos.customer_id was updated). Code path in customers.py:96-107 also updates projects, mrfs, pos, invoices collections — not exercised in this test since seeded data doesn't include these under a new test cid, but the update_many calls are byte-identical to the pre-refactor server.py implementation.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/masters.py — /import/materials/template accepts ?token= query fallback for browser downloads; that pattern is only used for Excel exports. Same pattern also exists on other Excel endpoints. Not a bug.

routers/customers.py:99-107 — Customer ID cascade rename does not use a MongoDB session/transaction; if any of the 5 update_many calls fail mid-stream the DB is left half-renamed. Pre-existing (matches server.py). Consider wrapping in a session for future hardening but out of scope for this refactor pass.
routers/masters.py:170-173 — pm_action 'flag' path writes new_status='needs_correction' but only sets approved_by/approved_at when action == 'approve'. Correct.

test_phase9c_r3_masters_customers.py::TestCustomersCRUD emits a PytestRemovedIn10Warning (class-scoped instance-method fixture). Non-blocking — tests pass, will migrate to @classmethod when pytest 10 lands.

success_rate.frontend: N/A — chip presence verified via code inspection only, per request

seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed (idempotent). Test data prefixed with TEST_ (materials, customers, masters). Test customers are soft-deleted at end of the CRUD flow; test materials remain in the DB but are searchable by TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Router refactor for Phase 9C is now regression-clean across 7 extracted routers (llm, notifications, reports, audit, settings, masters, customers). Two pytest suites are the source of truth: /app/backend/tests/test_phase9c_refactor.py (21 tests, ~1.5s — first 5 routers) and /app/backend/tests/test_phase9c_r3_masters_customers.py (45 tests, ~2.7s — masters + customers). Together they exercise every endpoint moved out of server.py. LLM UAT at /app/backend/tests/uat_llm_files.py (~1min, exit 0) covers the LLM flows. Any future router extraction should extend the r3 suite pattern.
